summary: All 11 tests PASSED. The React 18 rendering crash fix is verified working. The fix addresses two root causes: (1) Save flow - Dialog Portal removal and list DOM update now happen in SEPARATE render commits by closing dialog FIRST then firing load(true), (2) Tab switching - All 3 expense tabs are now keep-alive with CSS display:none toggling instead of conditional rendering. No 'insertBefore', 'insertOrAppendPlacementNode', or 'Maximum call stack' errors observed during any flow.
critical_code_review_comments: SAVE FLOW FIX VERIFIED: setShowAdd(false) called BEFORE load(true) in all 4 save flows (RawMaterialsTab line ~221, SalariesTab line ~363, OtherExpensesTab line ~452, SalesPage line ~169)
TAB SWITCHING FIX VERIFIED: CSS display:none toggling (lines 551-558) instead of conditional rendering - all 3 tabs stay mounted
KEY PROPS VERIFIED: key='loading'|'empty'|'data' on Card conditional branches prevents React DOM reconciliation errors
URL.createObjectURL used for image preview instead of base64 - prevents multi-MB strings in VDOM
extractingRef guard prevents double-execution of AI extraction

context_for_next_testing_agent: The React 18 rendering crash bug has been FIXED and VERIFIED. The fix involves: (1) Closing dialog FIRST before firing load(true) to ensure Portal removal and list DOM update happen in separate render commits, (2) Keep-alive tabs with CSS display:none instead of conditional rendering. All 11 tests passed including critical first-insert scenarios from empty state.

TEST_1_first_expense_CRITICAL.description: First expense saved from empty state: vendor='First Vendor', invoice='FIRST-001', item='Chicken', qty=5, price=10. List shows 1 row with $50.00. NO CRASH.

TEST_2_first_salary_CRITICAL.description: First salary saved from empty state: employee='Chef John', amount=$3000. List shows 1 row. NO CRASH.

TEST_3_first_other_expense_CRITICAL.description: First other expense saved from empty state: title='Rent', amount=$1500. List shows 1 row. NO CRASH.

TEST_4_first_sale_CRITICAL.description: First sale saved from empty state: total_sales=$5000, single day entry. List shows 1 row. NO CRASH.

TEST_5_tab_switching_after_save.description: Rapid tab switching between Raw Materials → Salaries → Other → Raw Materials → Salaries → Other. NO CRASH. Each tab shows its data.

TEST_6_tab_switching_data_preservation.description: Tab switching preserves data. Raw Materials shows data, switch to Salaries shows data, switch back to Raw Materials still shows data. NO CRASH.

TEST_9_dashboard_after_saves.description: Dashboard shows correct totals - Monthly Spending: $4.6k (Raw Materials $100.00, Salaries $3,000.00, Other $1,500.00), Monthly Sales: $5.0k. NO CRASH.

rca_of_the_issue.root_cause_1: SAVE FLOW: React 18 automatic batching combined setItems (empty→data DOM swap) + setShowAdd(false) (Dialog Portal removal) + setSaving(false) into ONE render commit. React tried to update DOM nodes inside the Dialog Portal while simultaneously removing the Portal → stale reference → insertBefore crash.
rca_of_the_issue.fix_1: Changed all 4 save flows to close dialog FIRST (setShowAdd(false)) then fire load(true). Dialog close + loading=true batch safely. Items arrive in a SEPARATE render (skeleton→table transition).
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause_2: TAB SWITCHING: Conditional rendering ({activeTab === 'x' && <Tab />}) unmounted/remounted entire tab components on switch, causing state loss and DOM reconstruction conflicts.
rca_of_the_issue.fix_2: Keep all 3 tabs mounted with CSS display:none toggling instead of conditional rendering.
rca_of_the_issue.verification: All 11 tests passed with no crash errors. The fix successfully separates Portal removal from list DOM updates into different render commits.
